releaseNotes: Major feature release: Granular Workflow Snapshots, Semantic Integrity Verification with Freshness Heuristics & Delta Anomaly Guard, Prebuilt Multi-Platform Docker Images, and Remote Announcements Feed.
changelog: Feature: Granular Workflow & Credentials Snapshots Subsystem with zero-downtime rollback, cloud sync, and retention lock (#v1.6.0)
Feature: Advanced Semantic Integrity Verification — entity counts, Freshness Heuristic (stale DB detection), and Delta Anomaly Guard (>30% drop warning)
Feature: Multi-state integrity badge (OK, Warning, Corrupt) in Dashboard with detailed diagnostics tooltip
Feature: Independent Remote News Feed in Dashboard fetching announcements without requiring app updates
Feature: Cloud Test Connection UI for S3, Google Drive, and OneDrive
Feature: Automated multi-platform Docker images (linux/amd64, linux/arm64) published to GHCR
Fix: Node.js 18+ fetch compatibility and improved timeout guards
